triage.kind_span: The Gabelli Utility Trust (the “Fund,” “we,” “us” or “our”) is issuing subscription rights (the “Rights”) to our common shareholders to purchase additional common shares

subject_names.span: The Gabelli Utility Trust (the “Fund,” “we,” “us” or “our”) is issuing subscription rights (the “Rights”)

subject_tickers.span: The Common Shares are listed on the New York Stock Exchange (“NYSE”) under the symbol “GUT.”

security_class.span: 55,200,877 Rights for 7,885,840 Common Shares Subscription Rights to Acquire Common Shares

rights_per_share.span: One Right will be issued in respect of each Common Share of the Fund outstanding as of the close of business on the Record Date.

rights_per_new_share.span: A holder of Rights may purchase one Common Share of the Fund for every seven Rights exercised.

price_reference.span: Seven Rights may be exercised at a price of $5.50 per Common Share (the “Subscription Price”).

record_date.span: Rights will be issued to holders of record of the Fund’s Common Shares as of the close business on March 11, 2021 (the “Record Date”).

expiration_date.span: which will be 5:00 PM Eastern Time on April 14, 2021 (the “Expiration Date”), unless otherwise extended.

transferable.span: The Rights are transferable and will be admitted for trading on the NYSE under the symbol “GUT RT”.

over_subscription.span: An over-subscription privilege will be offered, subject to the right of the Board of Trustees of the Fund (the “Board”) to eliminate the over-subscription privilege.

max_new_shares.span: 7,885,840 Common Shares of the Fund will be issued if all Rights are exercised.

notes: Prospectus supplement dated March 11, 2021. Fixed subscription price of $5.50 per Common Share (seven Rights per share), so price_pct and price_floor_pct_nav are null (no percent of NAV or market is stated). Record date: the summary and the Important Dates table state March 11, 2021, but the 'Terms of the Rights Offering' section states 'as of the close of business on March 11, 2020 (the “Record Date”' - a conflicting statement, apparently a typo; 2021-03-11 used. Rights trade on the NYSE as 'GUT RT'. The Board may eliminate the over-subscription privilege. Last NAV $4.12 vs price $7.65 on March 9, 2021 (premium).
